ideas.title: Hit the moon
ideas.critique: Aim-and-fire is a well-worn toy, and Keep the island level already gave the player a mini game. What's strong is that the hit changes the sky: the moon moves, and real embers with their own light fall, smoulder and draw friends to them. That is light the island never had, and a path tracer is the right tool to show it.

ideas.title: Lumi melts when bored
ideas.critique: Showing mood on Lumi has been done before through the camera, so the premise is familiar. Real soft-body deformation of Lumi's own mesh is new, though, and a puddle with eyes that slides around and gets poured back with a wobble is a character beat people would share. It only works if the jelly physics actually reads as jelly in motion.

ideas.title: An engraving of today
ideas.critique: A hatching post-process is a style the island has never had, and a border made of the friends' real words is a nice touch. But it is a static picture that goes up once a day, and filtering a traced still throws away what the path tracer is good at.

ideas.title: Turkey drop
ideas.critique: A delivery that arrives from outside and friends running to their own parcel is a scripted event of a kind the island knows well (see the paper boat). Parachutes falling and parcels floating and drifting ashore would be new physics, but only if they actually float on the water rather than being animated by hand.

ideas.title: Pitch to Pickles
ideas.critique: It is one more player mini game, close in form to the last one, and a chalked diamond is a predictable setting. Steering a berry's curve with the mouse and a hit landing in the sea with a splash give it a playable core people would replay.

ideas.title: The island's echo
ideas.critique: Speech that comes back slightly wrong is the mishearing gag of A word goes round again, and speech has already been turned into sand. Real sound, delayed and voiced by another friend, is the only new part, and it rests entirely on audio the island barely has.

ideas.title: A relief from a museum print
ideas.critique: This is A hill with my face again: a picture turned into depth and carved into the land, this time in stone. Grazing light on the relief is a fair use of the path tracer, and friends copying the poses is a small gag, but someone who knows the island will recognise the recipe.

ideas.title: Gravity takes a day off
ideas.critique: It is another world rule the whole island acts out, filmed from a distance, in the same mould as the seesaw and the sand. Things landing on clouds and raining back down would be a nice sight, but if the clouds are not solid physics it becomes a scripted float and nothing more.

ideas.title: Underground detector
ideas.critique: A new place with a glowing box that friends watch like TV is The island on TV moved underground. A dark shaft lit only by the tank's flashes is a real lighting idea, but once you have seen the friends gather, there is little reason to come back.

ideas.title: Lumi plays tennis with the sun
ideas.critique: It is another change to the island's light and time of day, after Lit from below. Moving the real sun so the sky colours jump with every stroke is a bold use of the whole sky, but the joke will be used up after the first rally.
